facts.fact: Malawi and China Eximbank signed an RMB 155.4 million loan for Phase I of the National Fibre Backbone Project (1,220 km on ESCOM transmission towers from Chitipa to Nsanje via Lilongwe, Blantyre and Zomba, connecting 24 of 28 districts); the deal record gives a 2017 start and a 2018 end, and the loan was ratified on 6 December 2016. The text does not say the fibre is lit.
